$comment: Text pool for the Nation prayer category.
requests: Wisdom and unity for our nation's leaders.
Praying for leaders at every level, from our city council to the nation's capital, to lead with wisdom, honesty, and humility.
For the men and women serving in our military and for the families waiting for them at home. Bring them home safe and give their families strength.
Lifting up teachers across the country as a new school year starts. Give them patience, energy, and joy in their work.
Our country feels so divided right now. Asking God for unity, for kindness between neighbors, and for people to really listen to one another.
Protect the police officers, firefighters, and paramedics in every town as they protect others. Help them feel how much they are appreciated.
Asking God to bless our nation with peace. May we be a people who do justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with Him.

As a veteran, I pray for this country every day. I pray for our leaders in city halls, statehouses, and in our nation's capital, that they would seek wisdom and set aside pride. I pray for the troops serving far from home, for teachers and nurses and first responders, and for ordinary families just trying to make it. Lord, heal what is broken in our land and help us love one another well.
details: Whatever our differences, we can all pray for the people who serve and lead us.
I am praying this for my grandchildren too, and for the country they will grow up in.
We pray for peace in our land and for each of us to do our part to love our neighbors.
God is still on His throne, and that gives me hope for the days ahead.
answers: Thank you for joining in prayer for our nation. I am encouraged by how many people are praying.
Grateful to see neighbors coming together and helping one another. God is answering prayer.
There is still a long way to go, but I am seeing signs of hope. Please keep praying.
Thankful for everyone who prays for our leaders and those who serve. God hears us.
